name: OKC_COVERAGE_TIME_INTERVALS
description: This table stores the information pertaining to coverage times for a time zone and its applicable days of the week. START_TIME and START_MINUTE columns stores start time information and END_TIME and END_MINUTE columns stores end time information.

columns.name: COVERAGE_TIME_INTERVAL_ID
columns.description: System generated unique identifier. Primary key column of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: COVERAGE_TIME_INTERVAL_GUID
columns.description: GUID generated code. This column is used for supporting import and export.

columns.name: START_HOUR
columns.description: Start Hour for the Coverage time.

columns.name: START_MINUTE
columns.description: Start Minute for the Coverage time.

columns.name: END_HOUR
columns.description: End Hour for the Coverage time.

columns.name: END_MINUTE
columns.description: End Minute for the Coverage time.

columns.name: SUN_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Sunday is covered.

columns.name: MON_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Monday is covered.

columns.name: TUE_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Tuesday is covered.

columns.name: WED_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Wednesday is covered.

columns.name: THU_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Thursday is covered.

columns.name: FRI_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Friday is covered.

columns.name: SAT_YN
columns.description: Flag to indicate if Saturday is covered.

columns.name: COVERAGE_TIME_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of Coverage Times record. (OKC_COVERAGE_TIMES_B. COVERAGE_TIME_ID)

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
